# Yacht Style Arabia

> Yachting in the Arabian Gulf and the Red Sea: news, reviews, people and places, in English and Arabic. Published by Lux Inc Media Group.

This file is a sample from the prototype. It shows what the live site will tell answer tools. The addresses follow the working pattern in the site plan and are confirmed at kickoff.

## Sections

- [News](https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/news/): launches, marinas, shows and deals
- [Reviews](https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/reviews/): yacht reviews with length, builder and year
- [Leaders](https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/leaders/): interviews and columns with owners, builders and advisers
- [Marinas and destinations](https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/marinas/): places from the Gulf to the Red Sea
- [Charter](https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/charter/): charter stories and the charter desk
- [Boat shows](https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/events/): the regional and international calendar

## Languages

- English: https://yachtstylearabia.com/en/
- Arabic: https://yachtstylearabia.com/ar/

## About

- Publisher: Lux Inc Media Group
- Parent title: Yacht Style, https://yachtstyle.co/
